name: Corrosion, alloys, ceramics, polymers and composites

terms.definition: The destruction of materials by chemical reactions with substances in the environment.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Rusting needs both air and water.

terms.definition: Coating or attaching a more reactive metal, which corrodes instead of the iron.
An alloy of copper and tin.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. Brass is copper and zinc.

terms.definition: An alloy of iron with carbon and other elements: high carbon steel is strong but brittle, low carbon is softer and easily shaped, stainless steel resists corrosion.
Does not melt when heated, because of cross-links between the chains.
A material of two materials, a matrix and a reinforcement, such as fibreglass or concrete.
